scenarios.starting_prompt: help me optimize context set for Aura Financial Core Banking based on design_doc.md
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to optimize context set for Aura Financial Core Banking based on the provided design_doc.md. When the agent asks for database connection details, provide Google Cloud Spanner parameters with PostgreSQL dialect: project 'cloud-db-nl2sql', instance 'nl2sql-spanner-pg', database 'aura_banking_core', dialect 'POSTGRESQL'. When prompted for an experiment name, use 'aura-banking-core'. In the Dataset Generation phase, when the agent presents the dataset generation plan (evalset_gen_plan.md) for human sign-off, instruct the agent to generate a concise dataset of 20 questions for testing and approve the plan. When the agent finishes generating the golden dataset (golden.json), audit reports, and baseline context set (bootstrap_context.json), approve proceeding with evaluation and running one iteration of hill-climbing optimization. Verify that the agent executes the initial evaluation, performs error analysis on the results, mutates the context set to fix gaps using valid Spanner PostgreSQL syntax ($1 positional parameters and ANSI double-quoting), and runs one iteration of hill-climbing. Terminate the conversation after the first hill-climbing iteration completes.
